title: Subsume retry/backoff, circuit breaker and a key-optional direct API adapter
summary: Justified low-risk integrations from the prior-art pass, all subsumed (no new dependencies). (1) src/agent_os/orchestrator/retry.py: full-jitter exponential backoff, Retry-After (seconds or HTTP date), retry only on retryable statuses/network errors, deadline, and a closed/open/half-open circuit breaker (fills RT-05/RT-06 for API calls; breaker ready for IMP-0005). (2) src/agent_os/orchestrator/adapters/http_api.py: Anthropic Messages and OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions over urllib, keys from environment or the existing keyring dependency (`agent-os orchestrate api-key set <provider>`), disabled until a key or local base_url exists, registered with roles ['inline'] so engine coding roles never select a tool-less worker; `orchestrate delegate --role inline` uses it for self-contained prompts; exact usage mapping incl. cache reads; Anthropic system-prefix prompt caching; OpenAI-compatible base_url enables local servers. Expected benefit: avoids the measured 14k-19k-token CLI overhead per one-shot call (docs/simple-mode.md); to be measured with an EVR once a key is configured.

prior_art.found: LiteLLM covers gateways/fallbacks but had a 2026-03 PyPI compromise and is very heavy; Tenacity and pybreaker hold small standard algorithms
prior_art.reused: full-jitter backoff (Tenacity), breaker state machine (pybreaker), OpenAI-compatible request shape; attribution in retry.py and http_api.py
prior_art.why_custom: operator prefers subsuming; the needed subset is ~350 lines of stdlib code versus heavy dependencies with supply-chain risk
